name: SIH 26171 - UI-detector follow-up spike
description: Research spike, not a feature. Benchmarks two UI/webpage-element detectors (onnx-community/OmniParser-icon_detect, OpenDILabCommunity/webpage_element_detection) via raw onnxruntime-web on WebGPU inside a Chrome MV3 offscreen document, following the exact harness pattern verified working in Phase 0 (spike/chrome-harness/). Neither model is transformers.js pipeline()-compatible (both are raw YOLOv8 exports), so this uses onnxruntime-web directly with hand-written pre/post-processing. No popup, no content script, no redaction logic.
